content.title: Susceptibility source separation via Closed-form Alternating Newton-type Optimization
content.abstract: Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping (QSM) provides a bulk magnetic susceptibility estimate per voxel, so contributions from paramagnetic and diamagnetic sources within the same voxel partially cancel. Susceptibility source separation methods identify these compartments by fitting a three-pool complex exponential model to multi-echo gradient-echo (GRE) data. However, conventional voxel-wise fitting with general-purpose constrained solvers requires several hours per whole-brain volume and often fails in high-susceptibility regions.
